claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an LG-branded monitor and a keyboard, matching the item description.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Monitor is shown powered off with a dark screen; no on-screen image is visible to confirm panel condition.
No remote control is visible in the photo; its presence cannot be confirmed.
Repair history cannot be determined from an external photo; no open casing or service sticker shown.

risks.risk: Monitor may not power on or display an image at all
risks.proof: A video or photo of the monitor powered on showing a clear image

risks.risk: Hidden screen damage (cracks, dead pixels, lines) not visible while off
risks.proof: Clear photo of the screen powered on, fully lit, showing no defects

risks.risk: Missing power adapter, HDMI/VGA cable, or stand screws
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and hardware laid out
risks.if_unproven: priced as monitor only, no accessories

risks.risk: Keyboard may be non-functional or missing keys beyond visible wear
risks.proof: Video of keyboard being typed on, showing all keys registering

risks.risk: No CPU/tower or mouse included despite being a 'computer' sale
risks.proof: Explicit confirmation/photo showing only monitor and keyboard are included
risks.if_unproven: priced as monitor + keyboard only, no system unit

risks.risk: Unknown monitor model/size/age affects value tier
risks.proof: Photo of full model/serial label on the back of the monitor

risks.risk: Claimed remote cannot be confirmed to exist or work
risks.proof: Photo of the remote alongside the monitor

proof_requests: Photo/video of the monitor powered on with a full-screen test image (white, black, color bars)
Photo of the back of the monitor showing model/serial number
Photo of all included cables, power adapter, and any remote
Video of the keyboard being typed on to confirm all keys work
Close-up photos of the screen bezel and casing for cracks or dents
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an LG monitor and keyboard, so the item can be priced at worst case (untested, scrap-grade, no accessories confirmed) pending the listed proofs to raise the price.
